seednet_fields.Parentage: Fodder bajra IP 20594 x Napier grass FD 437
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
Non-lodging, Highly responsive to fertilizers.
Fertilizer requirement:
FYM: 25t/ha
NPK: 150:50:40 kg/ha
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
-	Robust Tillering perennial grass
-	High leafy (400-430 leaves/clump); long and broad leaves (100 -110 cm long and 4.0 – 5.0 width).
-	Leaf colour: Medium green
-	Shape: Lanceolate
-	Texture: Soft
-	Leaf sheath: Glabrous
-	Leaf margin: Slightly serrated
-	Flower colour: Light yellow
-	Maturity group: Perennial grass
-	Seed to seed: 150 – 175 days
-	Set to flowering: 140-150 days
-	Inflorescence length (cm): 25-30 cm (Bristled) 
-	Florets per spikelet: Two (sterile)
-	Panicle colour: Light yellow
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Withsatands sewage irrigation and moderately tolerant to drought.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Green fodder yield:1082 q/ha/yr Dry matter yield:239.03 q/ha/yr Kg/Ha

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: BH 885 is tolerant to lodging; resistant to shattering; responsive to recommended doses of fertilizers and irrigations. Suitable for timely sown (10th -25th November) with a seed rate of 37.5 kg/acre.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Plant height : 90 cm, Distinguishing morphological character : The variety has medium height, erect spikes, high biomass and more grains per spike, Growth habit : Erect, Anthocyanin pigmentation, Coleoptile : Absent, Leaf sheath : Green, Auricle (at flag leaf stage) : Absent, Foliage colour (boot stage) : Dark green, Leaf width (boot stage) : Medium, Average day to heading : 84 days,  Average days to maturity : 129 days, Waxiness (at ear emeragence), Flag leaf : Non waxy, Leaf sheath : Waxy, Ear : Waxy, Peduncle : Waxy, Ear colour at maturity : Yellow, Ear shape : Parallel, Ear density : Intermediate, Six rowed / two rowed : Two rowed, Awns length : Intermediate, Awn colour (at flowering and maturity) : Green & yellow, Glume pubescence : Absent, Grain, Hulled/hull-less : Hulled, Colour : Whitish yellow, Texture : Fine, Crease width : Intermediate, Shape : Oval, 1000-grain weight (g) : 50.0
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: BH885 Performed better under salinity alkalinity stress conditions. The variety also showed minimum reduction in grain yield under terminal heat stress conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistance to yellow rust, brown rusts, leaf blight, stripe diseases and powdery mildew.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Average score against aphid attack under natural conditions. Tolerant to aphids and susceptible to CCN.

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Tolerant to lodging; resistant to shattering, responsive to recommended doses of fertilizers and irrigations; suitable for timely sown with a seed rate of 35-37.5 kg/acre
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
BH 946 is having semi erect growth habit at boot stage with profuse tillering and medium size dark green leaves.
ii) BH 946 has very strong stem and club shaped dense ear heads.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: BH 946 gave compatible yield performance to check NDB 1173 in salinity alkali trials. The variety also showed minimum reduction in grain yield under terminal heat stress conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: It exhibited excellent degree of resistance to yellow rust and leaf rusts, leaf blight, covered smut and powdery mildew.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: It showed at par reaction to checks against aphid attack.

J. Foliage colour (Boot stage)- Intermediate (semi-erect leaves).

seednet_fields.Parentage: Base populations: Base population comprising BB-2, IL2001-409, IL2001-439, IL2001-114 and IL2001-514. Breeding method: Phentypic recurrent selection
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: JHB-18-2 was identified and recommended for release in the states of Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, UT of Jammu and Kashmir, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Resistant to H. armigera; and resistant to moderately susceptible to aphid
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Late in initiation of flowering, late maturity, broad leaf, fast regrowth and bold seed size.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: JHB-18-2 requires an average of 145 days from seedling stage to initiation of flowering, 155 days seedling to 50% flowering and 185 days from seedling to seed maturity.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Resistant to root rot diseases, moderately resistant to, resistant to stem rot

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: CHAUDHARY SARWAN KUMAR KRISHI VISHVA VIDYALAYA, HAREC, DHALAKUAN/ CSKHPKV, PALAMPUR.
seednet_fields.Parentage: UPU-00-31 (UPU 97-10 X DPU 88-1) DEVELOPED AT GBPUA&T, PANTNAGAR.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: RECOMMENDED FOR CULTIVATION IN LOW HILLS SUBTROPICAL ZONE IN KHARIF SEASON.
seednet_fields.Maturity (in days): IT MATURES IN ABOUT 75 DAYS i.e.ABOUT A WEEK EARLIER AS COMPARED TO VARIETY UG-216 (80.0 DAYS) AND U 19 (79.0 DAYS) AT DHAULAKUAN. IT IS SYNCHRONOUS IN MATURITY.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: I. COMPACT AND ERECT PLANT, SYNCHRONOUS MATURITY DETERMINATE WITH THICK STEM 2. PODS IN BUNCHES 3. DARK GREEN, BROAD LEAVES.4. GRAINS ARE MEDIUM BOLD AND BROWNISH BLACK
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT : 61-70 CM, IT BEARS MEDIUM SIZED PODS IN BUNMCHES WITH 6-7 DUAL BLACK, MEDIUM BOLD SEEDS. THE PLANTS GROW ERECT AND ARE SHORT IN HEIGHT AND ITS FOLIAGE COLOUR IS GREEN , FLOWER COLOUR : YELLOW, NO OF PRIMARY BRANCHES : 3-4, NO. OF PODS/PLANT : 37.6, NO OF CLUSTER/PLANT : 19.8 POD LENGTH : 6.6 100 SEED WT. 4.4GM
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: IT IS RESISTANT TO ANTHRACNOSE, VIRAL DISEASES (MOONGBEAN YELLOW MOSAIC VIRUS AND LEAF CRINKLE) AND TOLERANT TO CERCOSPORA LEAF SPOT AND POWEDRY MILDEW, BLISTER BEETLE AND HAIRY CATERPILLAR ARE THE MAJOR PESTS OF URDBEAN. GENOTYPE IS NOT RESISTANT O THESE INSECTS. HOWEVER, DUE TO LESS FOLIAGE AND EARLY MATURITY IT ESCAPES THE ATTACK OF THESE INSECTS TO SOME EXTENT.

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: North Eastern Plains Zone (NEPZ) comprising wheat growing areas of Eastern UP, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal and Plains of NE states.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: (1)	DBW 252 (37.7 q/ha) yielded higher than sown recent check variety HD 3171 (37.5 q/ha) in agronomical experiments at different irrigation levels. (2)	It showed significant yield superiority over popular check varieties HD 2888 (16.0%) and K 8027 (17.8%) at all the irrigation levels. (3)	It also showed higher yield advantage (13.0%) at increased irrigation level (2-irrigations) (9.0%) and HD 3171 (7.9%). (4)	Additionally, DBW 252 also has hihest grain number per spike (30.8) and comparable performance for spike number/m2 (307) and 1000-grains weight (42g).
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: DBW 252 has Drought Sensivity Index (DSI) of 0.74 based on evaluations in multilocational DTSN and is categorized as a Drought Tollerant variety.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases:
(a)	DBW 252 is highly resistance (Av 2.5%) to wheat blast disease which is a potential threat for wheat crop in NEPZ. None of the checks were resistance (Av<10.0).
(b)	DBW 252 showed high resistance to leaf (ACI-3.4) and stripe (ACI-18.1) rusts. It also showed high degree of adult plant resistance to leaf rust. 
(c)	Better resistance to Karnal bunt (Av.5.1%), leaf blight (Av.45) and powdery mildew (Av.3) was observed in DBW 252.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: There is no major problem of insect pests in NEPZ. However, DBW 252 showed better resistance to shoot fly and brown wheat mite under controlled conditions as compared to check varieties.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): 14.50 q/acre to 15.2q/acre with mean  yield of 14.8q/acre and yield potential of 22.2q/acre. Kg/Ha
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 90:60:40 (N:P:K) 1/2 or 1/3 at sowing and remaining at first node stage.

seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Field resistant to backterial wilt in wilt sick plot, Moderately resistant to Phomopsis blight
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Tolerant to fruit borer during early winter season.

Table quality attributes/Nutritional quality: White compact curd, free from bracts and riceyness. seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Regional Agricultural Research Station, Nandyal; ANGRAU, Guntur (Andhra Pradesh)
seednet_fields.Parentage: It is a selection from ICCV 37 X ICC 12451. The cross was made at ICRISAT and advance breeding line was supplied to RARS, Nandyal.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Suitable for cultivation in all chickpea growing districts in Andhra Pradesh during rabi season under rainfed conditions.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: 1.	In AICRP trials (2015-16) under normal planting sates (with 20 kg N and 50 kg P2O5 kg/ha) tested at six locations, N BeG 452 recorded 8.74 per cent (1344 kg/ha) higher yield than GCP 101 (1236 kg/ha) and 15.6 per cent higher yield than JG 315 (1163 kg/ha). 2.	At RARS, Nadyal (2019-20), N BeG 452 recorded 19.6 per cent (2205 kg/ha higher) yield at 20 kg N/ha compared to no nitrogen application (1844 kg/ha) and at 40 kg N/ha 24.7 per cent increased yield (2299 kg/ha) was recorded which is on par with 20 kg N/ha.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Semi spreading plant type, medium in height, green with anthocyanin pigmentation. It has small leaflets, pink flowers, and attractive. Pods with bold seeds.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: On par with check/popular varieties in its reaction to major diseases.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: NBeG 452 is on par with tolerant check in its reaction to pod borer Helicoverpa.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Basal application of 20:50 kg N: P2O5 per ha. Basal application of ZnSo4 @ 20 kg/ha.

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: ICAR-AINP on Arid Legumes Rajasthan Agricultural Research Institute, Durgapura, (SKNAU, Jobner), Jaipur (Rajasthan)
seednet_fields.Parentage: The variety has been developed through pedigree method from the hybridization between RGC-1038 x RGC-1017
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Lodging & shattering resistant, responsive to inputs, suitable for timely sown conditions
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
1.	Habit: Branched, erect and indeterminate plant type Pink
2.	Flower colour: Pink
3.	Seed colour: Light grey with black brown eye
4.	Leaf type: Trip innate type
5.	Leaf serration: Serrated margin
6.	Plant pubescence: Pubescent
7.	Seed shape: Flat and Round
8.	Pod shape: Straight and Hairy
9.	Plant Height: Medium tall
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Proposed variety has higher degree of resistance with major diseases like bacterial blight, root rot and alternaria leaf blight
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Minimum incidence of white fly, leaf hopper and aphid was observed as compared to check variety
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 20 kg N and 40 kg P2O5/ha as basal application at the time of sowing through drill. Application of zinc sulphate @ 15-20 kg/ha also improves the yield.

Guwahati-781017, Assam
seednet_fields.Parentage: Local pureline selection, collected from village: Dodora, Mandal: Hajo, Dist-Kamrup, Assam
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Rain fed area of Assam, Especially in the Bais (homestead) system of cultivation in the north east region wherein most of the farmers tend to grow a few coconut palms in their holdings.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Having good responsiveness to major nutrients i.e., NPK as well as micro nutrient more particularly to boron
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Tolerant to high rainfall (from June to August) and semi-waterlogged condition, hight humidity, low temperature (during winter) and acidic soil (pH: 4.5  5.5)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Tolerant to stem bleeding caused by Thielaviopsis paradoxa, Bud rot (Phytophthora palmigvora) and Grey leaf spot (Pestalotia palmarum).

csc_fields.special_traits: Plant height: 733.82 cm 28 years after planting. Distinguishing morphological characteristics: The palms are semi tall without prominent bole. The colour of the petiole is green. The variety bears green coloured, oval fruits and the dehusked fruits are found in shape. The seedlings are vigourous, producing more number of leaves within 12 months, having more leaf area and dry weight. Characteristics different from those of the parents: The female parent palms are dwarf, takes 66 months for flowering, bears bright yellow fruits and has yellow petiole colour. The male parent palms are tall, bearing green fruits and takes about 98 months for flowering. The palms of IND 376 bear bright green fruits; have bright green petioles; semi tall habit, takes 45 months for initiation of flowering; and profuse bearing. Description of variety: Age of measurement (years) 28, Category Semi Tall, Crown shape Circular, Presence of bole Absent, Plant height (cm) 733.82, Girth of trunk (cm) 69.36, Total number of leaves 33, Length of petiole (cm) 122.27, Length of leaflet bearing portion (cm) 376.45, Number of leaflets 109, Length of leaflet (cm) 122.73, Breadth of leaflet (cm) 6.01, No. of leaf scars in 1 m length 25, Length of 10 internodes (cm) 39.18, Age at 50% flowering (months) 60, Length of inflorescence (cm) 88.64, Length of spikelet bearing portion (cm) 40.36, Length of stalk (m) 48.27, Length of spikelet (cm) 41.09, No. of spikelet's in the inflorescence 37.18, Number of female flowers 26, Number of inflorescences on the crown 14, Colour and shape of fruit Green, Oval, Length of fruit (cm) 19.38, Breadth of fruit (cm) 15.44, Weight of fruit (g) 1032.33, Thickness of husk (cm) Apical 6.00, Distal 2.75, Equatorial 2.35, Shape of nut Round. Weight of nut (g) 681.33, Percent of husk to whole fruit weight 34.0, Thickness of kernel (cm) 1.77, Weight of kernel (g) 359.67, Weight of copra (g) 219.46. Agronomic features: The palms are regular bearers and commence flowering in 45 months after planting under rain fed conditions. The average time taken for flowering of 50% of the palms in the hybrid population is 60 months. Higher nitrogen use efficiency was observed in the seedling of the proposed hybrid. Quality attributes: The average quantity of tender nut water is 346 ml. Based on the organoleptic test; the tender nut water is classified as -good- in taste with a TSS of 6- Brix. The tender nut water has Na content of 35.1 ppm and K content of 2370 ppm. The oil extracted from the copra of this hybrid is having 45.4% lauric acid. Recommended for Table/processing/export/any other. Reaction to environmental stress: Tolerant to drought. Reaction to major diseases: No major disease out break observed under field conditions. Reaction to major pests: No Major pest attacks observed under field conditions.

csc_fields.breeding_method: Selection from IND 058 (Malayan Yellow Dwarf) used as female parent and selection from IND 069 (West Coast Tall) used as male parent.

seednet_fields.Parentage: This variety was a selection made from the land race collected from Koilakuntal village of Kurnool district by practicing mass selection. This variety was tested under the name LCC-170 in different yield evaluation trials conducted at Horticultural Research Station. Lam and in All India COordinated COmparative Yield Trials conducted at different locations.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Recommended for release and cultivation in the States of Tamilnadu, Haryana and Bihar. Maturity 75-95 days. Average yield 10 qtls./ha under irrigated conditions.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: This variety responds well to recommended dose of fertilizers 45 kg of N, 40 Kg of P2O5 and 40 Kg of K2O with seed rate of 15 kg seed per hectare, 30 x 10 cm spacing sown in second fortnight of October to first fortnight of November.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: a) Plant height: 50-70 cm, b) Distinguishing morphological characters: - Growth habit: Semi-erect plant with 6-9 primary branches and 10 to 16 secondary branches., - Leaves: Leaves raised with an arcus of 45 degree longest basal leaf is deeply incised with 3 lobes, upper leaves more than twice pinnate. Plants have medium foliage., - Stem: Greenish stem, - Inflorescence: Inflorescence contains 18-25 umbels and 5 to 8, - Seed Colour: umbettets per per umbel with 30-50 schizocarps per, - Weight of 1000 seeds: umble.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: This variety is less susceptible to diseases. No significant damage from any disease observed during evolution of the variety.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: This variety is less susceptible to pests. No significant damage from any pest observed during evolution of the variety.

csc_fields.meeting_title: Minutes of the 17th meeting of Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties for Horticultural Crops
csc_fields.special_traits: Plant height: 50 to 70 cm. Growth habit: Semi-erect plant with 6-9 primary branches and 10 to 16 secondary branches. Leaves: Raised with an arcus of 45- longest basal leaf, deeply incised with 3 lobes, upper leaves more than twice pinnate. Plants have medium foliage. Stem: Greenish stem. Inflorescence: Contains 18-25 umbels and 5 to 8 umbellets per umbel with 30-50 schizocarps per umble. Grains are oblong in shape with medium size with high volatile oil content (0.40-0.45%). Less susceptible to diseases. No significant damage from any disease or pest observed during evolution of the variety.
csc_fields.breeding_method: A selection made from the land race collected from Koilakuntla village of Kurnool district by practicing mass selection. Tested under the name LCC-170 in different yield evaluation trials conducted at Horticultural Research Station. Lam and in All India Coordinated Comparative Yield Trials.
csc_fields.yield_performance: Average yield 10 Qtls./Ha under irrigated conditions; 8.5 to 10 Qtls/ha under rainfed cultivation; 12 to 15 Qtls./ha under irrigated cultivation.
csc_fields.additional_notes: Recommended for notification for entire country.

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: S.K.N. college of Agriculture, (Rajasthan Agricultural University) Campur - Jobner 303329.
seednet_fields.Parentage: The Variety has been developed through recurrent selection based on individual plant progeny (half sib) performance in UD-728 which was a local collection from Garoth, Mandsaur (MP).
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Recommended for release and cultivation in the States of Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and Haryana under irrigated conditions. Medium maturity.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: i. Sowing time: Last week of October to first week of November is the best sowing time for the variety., ii. Seed rate and spacing: A seed rate of 10-12 kg/ha is enough. Sowing should be done behind the plough in rows keeping 30 cm apart., iii. Irrigation: Three to six irrigations depending upon oil type and weather conditions., iv. Fertilizers and manures: 5-10 tones of FYM, 60 KgN/ha, 30 kg P2O5 and 20 Kg K2O in the form of fertilizers are required to obtain best results, Nitrogen should be applied in 3 equal splits; 1/3 of total Nitrogen, total P2O5 and 20 Kg K2O at the time of sowing one third Nitrogen at 45 DAS and remaining one third at flowering stage should be applied.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: a) Plant height: 78.05 cm, b) Distinguishing morphological characters: 1. Bushy and erect plant type., 2. Early growth vigour is high.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: It was found free from stemgall and powdery mildew while it was found to be moderately resistant to wilt and root knot nematode.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Coriander is attached by aphids, infection intensity is at par with other cultivars.

seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANTS IS DWARF HAS PURPLE PIGMENTATION ON THE JOINTS ON STEM AND LEAVES AS WELL AS ON CALYX AND POD TIPS BUT THE FLOWERS ARE WHITE WITH A PURPLE LINE ON THE BACK OF THE STANDARD PETAL. VL Ragi 146/ VL Ragi 149

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: The culture is recommended for the release in Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Puducherry and Odisha.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Resistant to lodging. Suitable for early and late kharif under rainfed conditions. The culture is fertilizer responsive even upto 125% Recommended Dose of Fertilizer. Suitable for direct sowing and transplanting with seed rate of 5 kg/ha for transplanting and 7 kg/ha for direct sowing.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: The plant is highly purple pigmented with compact ears and the seed is copper brown in colour.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Highly resistant to finger & neck blast, banded sheath blight and foot rot. It is recognized as promising entry.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Grain yield of 30 – 35 q/ha under assured rainfall 15-20 q/ha under rainfed conditions Kg/Ha

seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Moderately tolerant to stem borer (%), plants and panicles affected by shoot aphid (%), myllocerus weevil and tolerant to grasshoppers (no.) and defoliators (%).

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar – 263145 Disst. Udham Singh Nagar, (Uttarakhand)
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Irrigated winter/Rabi season cultivation in plains of Uttarakhand including Tarai and Bhabar regions for fodder production.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Tolerant to seed shattering, good response to nitrogenous fertilizer on green forage, dry matter and crud protein yields. Suitable for irrigated winter/Rabi cultivation under timely sown conditions.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Obtuse, slightly bent leaves, equilateral panicle, whitish yellow seed, glabrous lemma and no awns.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Adapted to low moisture conditions and moderately tolerant to other edaphic stresses.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistant to leaf blight, crown rust (P. caronata f. sp. avenae) and loose smut (Ustilago avenae) under field conditions.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 80:60:40 (N:P:K) : Half of the N at sowing  and rests ½ N at 30-35 days after sowing (DAS). Additional N @ 25 kg/ha after first cut in multi cut (MC) forager oat.

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Spikelets (grains) tolerant to shattering, good response nitrogenous fertilizers on green forage and dry fodder yields (Table 9(a) & 9(b)) and crude protein yield (Table 9). Suitable for mixed cropping with berseem for irrigated winter under early and late sown conditions in plains and lower hills of Uttarakhand
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Erect, medium tall, lush green abundant foliage, mediurri wide,	slightly	 bent leaves. Semi-equilateral erect, 35-40 cm long panicles, globrous lemma, no awns, whitish yellow seed
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Tolerant to low moisture conditions and moderately tolerant to other edaphic stresses
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistance to leaf rust {P. coronata. f.sp. avenae ), smut Ustilago avenae ), leaf blight (H. avenae ) under field conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Resistance to aphids, grasshopper at field level.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Green forage yield from 350 q/ha to 450 q/ha (Average yield over three years of testing in SVT of Uttarakhand and Coordinated (ICAR) Ttrials. Genetic potential of the variety 550 q/ha green forage yield. Seed yield 20-25q/ha. Kg/Ha
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 80:50:30 (N:P;K) : Half of the N at sowing and rests /2 N at 30-35 days after sowing (DAS). Additional N@, 25 kg/ha after first cut in multicut (MC) forage oat.

seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Salinity tolerant and performs very well upto 8ds/m.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: It is showing tolerance to anthracnose, downy mildew and foliar diseases and has good performance as compared to check.

Clonal selection from garlic
Collections of Belgaum district.

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Suitable for commercial cultivation under Belgaum i.e. Zone-3, Region-2 of Karnataka during rabi season.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
Suitable for sowing during rabi (2nd fortnight of October to 2nd fortnight of November) northern dry zone of Karnataka.
Seed rate : 375 to 500 kg/ha
Cloves of garlic bulb should be sown/dibbled in rows of 15 cm at a plant to plant spacing of 7.5 cm apart.
Fertilizers
FYM : 25 t/ha
NPK: 125:62.5 : 62.5 kg/ha
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Pink coloured cloves with an average of 20 cloves per bulb.

csc_fields.meeting_title: Minutes of the 28th meeting of Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties for Horticultural Crops
csc_fields.additional_notes: General regulatory guidelines and conditions for consideration of proposals for release and notification of Horticultural crop & variety by the committee:, 1. Sponsoring Institute/organization should ensure that the proposals are submitted in proper format and must have the required documents viz., acknowledgement certificate regarding submission of seed sample with NBPGR, detailed morphological characters of varieties, AICRP data on disease and pests reaction, source of material and pedigree, package of practices of the cultivar, DNA fingerprinting profile, A-4 size coloured photographs on glossy sheet etc., 2. The committee will not consider any proposal for release or notification in case the copy of proposal is not submitted to respective Director/Project Coordinator., 3. The proposals will be submitted through email (cvrc.hort-agri@gov.in). Five signed original hard copies will be submitted to Deputy Commissioner (Quality Control), DAC&FW, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi for records., 4. Each sponsoring institution/breeder will make of the proposal., 5. ICAR Institutes, SAUs and other organizations should devise a naming system of the name of Institute followed by crop name and then serial number of variety. Proposals with names of family members, gods and goddesses will not be accepted., 6. Any proposal with more than five years old data will not be considered by the committee., Meeting closure note: The meeting ended with a vote of thanks to the Chair.

seednet_fields.Parentage: Cross derivative from COGG 923 x VC 6040A
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
Branches : 2-3
Secondaries (No.) : -
Leaves : Dark green leaves, terminal leaflet shape is ovate.
Pods : Dark brown colored pods at maturity and presence of pod pubescence.
Seed Colour : Dull green coloured and drum shaped seed
100-seed weight(g) : 3.5 to 4.0
Protein content (%) : 20.21

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Best suited to irrigated and rainfed Groundnut growing areas
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Medium tall plant with dark green and oblong leaves.  Suitable for drought-prone groundnut growing areas. Remains green till harvest.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Medium tall plant with dark green foliage, resembling ICGV 00350 with bolder pods and profuse bearing (Plates 1&3)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Tolerant to early season drought with high Proline and high relative water content and quick regenerative Capacity.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistant to Leaf spots and rust diseases
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Tolerant to Sucking pests such as Thrips and Jassids
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Basal: 18-20N-100 kg P2O5-33 kg K2O 1st top dressing at 20-25 DAS: 10 kg N/Acre 200 kgs Gypsum at 40-45 DAS.

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
TNLC 12 can be cultivated throughout the year under irrigated conditions 
Non lodging as the stems are firm when compared to CO 1 
Seeds are completely intact with the pod and non shattering

Fertilizer requirement: : 
FYM : 25 t/ha
NPK : 25: 120: 40 kg/ha as basal 
Top dressing (once in a year during seed
production): NPK - 15: 120: 40 kg/ha.
Seed rate : 20 kg/ha.
Sowing : In beds of size 10 or 20 m²
Spacing : 25 cm apart in lines
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: Dark green and lanceolate shaped leaflets with acuminate shaped stipules. Profusely flowering nature with purple flowers.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
Leaf colour: Dark green
Leaf shape : Comprise three smooth, slightly toothed, lanceolate shaped leaflets.
4th Leaf length(cm) : 3.5-3.9
4th leaf width (cm) : 1.3-1.5
No. of leaf axils/stem : 9-11
Leaf stem ratio : 0.47
Shape of stipules : Medium, acuminate
Plant height (cm) : 70-80
No,. of stems per crown : 15-20
Stem girth (cm) : 1.2-1.4
Days to 50% flowering : 65-70 days
Flower colour : Purple
Length of flower cluster (cm) : 2.5-3.0
No. of pods per stem : 18-20
No. of spirals per pod : 3-5
No. of seeds per pod : 4-6
Seed colour : Golden yellow
Seed size : Medium bold
1000 seed weight (g) : 3.6
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: It does not tolerate severe drought and water logging.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Green fodder yield: 120-130 t/ha/yr Dry matter yield: 20-22 t/ha/yr Crude protein(%): 23.5 Crude protein yield : 5.25 t/ha/yr. Kg/Ha

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology:
South India
Rainfed conditions, suitable for sole, intercropping and sequence cropping system.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Normal sowing period is recommended in South India. Whenever NE Monsoon is prevalent, delayed sowing can be taken up.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Compact semi erect plant type, early duration large number of pods, brown coloured seeds
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Resistant to drought. The variety showed tolerance to drought as in test years the crop faced moisture stress inspite of that it recorded high yields.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: The proposed variety showed better tolerance to various diseases.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: The proposed variety showed higher tolerance to pests.

seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Plants tall in height (165-175 cm), moderately branched, plant vigorous, leaves medium in size, dark green in colour, medium maturity (1250130 days), seed bold in size (5.30g/1000 seeds), seed black in colour, silique beaded and open type, high oil content (42.6%), moderately resistant to alternaria blight and aphida.
